_comment: ROW 704 -- pagination, sort and category routes are not scenes, and the listing rule is DATA the templates extend rather than a second closed root list (generation f's escape). Every anchor is ZERO-WIDTH and sits on a decision: the template-extension update, the second-segment rule, its depth bound and the listing-keyword precedence. The transform control is in its own file beside this one and MUST escape.
subject: a route whose second segment is a listing word refuses whatever its root, at any depth, and templates can extend the word list

mutants.label: M1 the template-declared listing words are dropped (the defaults must still refuse the rootless cases)
mutants.new: x for x in () if x or

mutants.label: M2 rule B2 is dropped, leaving only the closed keyword list
M3 the rule is restricted to short routes, so a 4-segment listing escapes
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^        if len\(segments\) )(?=>= 2 and segments\[1\] in listing_words:$)

mutants.label: M4 the locale-prefix normalisation is skipped, so a localed listing route escapes the second-segment rule
